```{=html}
<style>
.sn-header {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a2a4a 0%, #2d4a8c 60%, #3a5aad 100%);
  color: #f5f0e8;
  padding: 1.4rem 2rem;
  border-radius: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.sn-header .sn-title {
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin: 0 0 0.25rem;
}
.sn-header .sn-title span { color: #a2b8f0; }
.sn-header .sn-sub {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  opacity: 0.85;
  margin: 0;
}
.sn-controls {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}
.sn-controls select {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem;
  border-radius: 6px;
  border: none;
}
.sn-meta {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: #888;
  margin: -0.6rem 0 1rem;
}

/* Market summary */
.sn-market {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
  gap: 0.9rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.4rem;
}
.sn-idx-card {
  border: 1px solid #e5e5e5;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 0.9rem 1.1rem;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
}
.sn-idx-name {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #555;
  margin: 0 0 0.3rem;
}
.sn-idx-close {
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin-right: 0.5rem;
}
.sn-idx-change {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.sn-idx-up .sn-idx-close, .sn-idx-up .sn-idx-change { color: #c0392b; }
.sn-idx-down .sn-idx-close, .sn-idx-down .sn-idx-change { color: #2f5aa8; }
.sn-idx-flat .sn-idx-close, .sn-idx-flat .sn-idx-change { color: #666; }
.sn-idx-meta {
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: #999;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem 0.8rem;
}

/* Source cards grid */
.sn-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr));
  gap: 1.2rem;
}
.sn-source-card {
  border: 1px solid #e5e5e5;
  border-radius: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
}
.sn-source-head {
  padding: 0.7rem 1.1rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}
.sn-source-head a {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 400;
  color: #888;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.sn-source-head a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.sn-list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}
.sn-item {
  padding: 0.85rem 1.1rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #f2f2f2;
}
.sn-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.sn-item h3 {
  margin: 0 0 0.3rem;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
}
.sn-item h3 a {
  color: #1f3d33;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.sn-item h3 a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.sn-summary {
  margin: 0 0 0.35rem;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: #555;
  line-height: 1.6;
}
.sn-item-meta {
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  color: #999;
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}
.sn-tag {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: #3a5aad;
  background: #eef2fb;
  border-radius: 5px;
  padding: 0.05rem 0.4rem;
}
.sn-rank {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #3a5aad;
  margin-right: 0.4rem;
}
.sn-error {
  color: #a33;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  padding: 0.9rem 1.1rem;
}
.sn-empty {
  color: #999;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
}
.sn-footnote {
  margin-top: 1.4rem;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: #999;
  line-height: 1.6;
}
</style>

<div class="sn-header">
  <div>
    <div class="sn-title">📈 <span>오늘의 증권가 주식 소식</span></div>
    <p class="sn-sub">네이버 증권·매일경제 증권 뉴스와 코스피·코스닥 시황을 매일 자동 수집</p>
  </div>
  <div class="sn-controls">
    <label for="sn-date-select">날짜</label>
    <select id="sn-date-select"></select>
  </div>
</div>

<p class="sn-meta" id="sn-generated-at"></p>

<div class="sn-market" id="sn-market">
  <p class="sn-empty">시황 데이터를 불러오는 중입니다…</p>
</div>

<div class="sn-grid" id="sn-grid">
  <p class="sn-empty">데이터를 불러오는 중입니다…</p>
</div>

<p class="sn-footnote">
  뉴스는 <a href="https://finance.naver.com/news/news_list.naver?mode=LSS2D&section_id=101&section_id2=258" target="_blank" rel="noopener">네이버 증권 &gt; 뉴스 &gt; 증권</a> 및
  <a href="https://www.mk.co.kr/news/stock/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">매일경제 &gt; 증권</a> 섹션에 노출되는 기사 제목·요약·시각을,
  시황은 네이버 증권의 코스피·코스닥 지수를 매일 자동으로 그대로 수집·정리한 것으로, 본 사이트가 별도로 내용을 가공하거나 순위를 산정하지 않습니다.
  기사 본문은 각 언론사 원문 링크에서 확인할 수 있습니다. 본 정보는 참고용이며 투자 결정의 책임은 본인에게 있습니다.
</p>

<script>
(function () {
  const grid = document.getElementById("sn-grid");
  const market = document.getElementById("sn-market");
  const select = document.getElementById("sn-date-select");
  const meta = document.getElementById("sn-generated-at");
  const cache = new Map();

  function escapeHtml(str) {
    return String(str).replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({
      "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;",
    }[c]));
  }

  function directionClass(direction, change) {
    if (direction === "상승" || (change && !change.startsWith("-") && change !== "0.00" && change !== "0")) return "sn-idx-up";
    if (direction === "하락" || (change && change.startsWith("-"))) return "sn-idx-down";
    return "sn-idx-flat";
  }

  function renderMarket(marketData) {
    if (!marketData || marketData.status === "error" || !marketData.indices || !marketData.indices.length) {
      market.innerHTML = `<p class="sn-error">시황 데이터를 불러오지 못했습니다${marketData && marketData.error ? ": " + escapeHtml(marketData.error) : ""}.</p>`;
      return;
    }
    market.innerHTML = marketData.indices.map((idx) => {
      const cls = directionClass(idx.direction, idx.change);
      const sign = cls === "sn-idx-up" ? "+" : "";
      return `
      <div class="sn-idx-card ${cls}">
        <p class="sn-idx-name">${escapeHtml(idx.name)}</p>
        <span class="sn-idx-close">${escapeHtml(idx.close)}</span>
        <span class="sn-idx-change">${sign}${escapeHtml(idx.change)} (${sign}${escapeHtml(idx.changeRate)}%)</span>
        <div class="sn-idx-meta">
          <span>거래대금 ${escapeHtml(idx.tradingValue || "-")}</span>
          <span>고가 ${escapeHtml(idx.high || "-")} · 저가 ${escapeHtml(idx.low || "-")}</span>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    }).join("");
  }

  function renderSources(sources) {
    grid.innerHTML = sources.map((source) => {
      const items = source.items || [];
      if (source.status === "error" || !items.length) {
        return `
        <div class="sn-source-card">
          <div class="sn-source-head">${escapeHtml(source.label)} <a href="${escapeHtml(source.sourceUrl)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">원본 ↗</a></div>
          <p class="sn-error">${source.status === "error" ? "수집 실패" + (source.error ? ": " + escapeHtml(source.error) : "") : "데이터 없음"}</p>
        </div>`;
      }
      const listHtml = `<ul class="sn-list">${items.map((it) => `
          <li class="sn-item">
            <h3><span class="sn-rank">${it.rank}</span><a href="${escapeHtml(it.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${escapeHtml(it.title)}</a></h3>
            ${it.summary ? `<p class="sn-summary">${escapeHtml(it.summary)}</p>` : ""}
            <div class="sn-item-meta">
              ${it.tag ? `<span class="sn-tag">${escapeHtml(it.tag)}</span>` : ""}
              ${it.press ? `<span>${escapeHtml(it.press)}</span>` : ""}
              ${it.time ? `<span>${escapeHtml(it.time)}</span>` : ""}
            </div>
          </li>`).join("")}</ul>`;
      return `
      <div class="sn-source-card">
        <div class="sn-source-head">${escapeHtml(source.label)} <a href="${escapeHtml(source.sourceUrl)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">원본 ↗</a></div>
        ${listHtml}
      </div>`;
    }).join("");
  }

  function renderSnapshot(snapshot) {
    meta.textContent = "생성 시각: " + (snapshot.generatedAt || snapshot.date);
    renderMarket(snapshot.market);
    renderSources(snapshot.sources || []);
  }

  async function loadSnapshot(date) {
    if (cache.has(date)) return cache.get(date);
    const res = await fetch(`../data/stock_news/${date}.json`);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    const data = await res.json();
    cache.set(date, data);
    return data;
  }

  async function onDateChange() {
    grid.innerHTML = '<p class="sn-empty">데이터를 불러오는 중입니다…</p>';
    market.innerHTML = '<p class="sn-empty">시황 데이터를 불러오는 중입니다…</p>';
    try {
      const snapshot = await loadSnapshot(select.value);
      renderSnapshot(snapshot);
    } catch (err) {
      grid.innerHTML = `<p class="sn-error">이 날짜의 데이터를 불러오지 못했습니다: ${escapeHtml(err.message)}</p>`;
      market.innerHTML = "";
    }
  }

  async function init() {
    try {
      const res = await fetch("../data/stock_news/manifest.json");
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
      const manifest = await res.json();
      const dates = manifest.dates || [];
      if (!dates.length) {
        grid.innerHTML = '<p class="sn-empty">아직 수집된 데이터가 없습니다. 첫 자동 수집은 매일 오전 8시 10분경 실행됩니다.</p>';
        market.innerHTML = "";
        return;
      }
      select.innerHTML = dates.map((d) => `<option value="${d}">${d}</option>`).join("");
      select.addEventListener("change", onDateChange);
      await onDateChange();
    } catch (err) {
      grid.innerHTML = `<p class="sn-error">뉴스 데이터를 불러오지 못했습니다: ${escapeHtml(err.message)}</p>`;
      market.innerHTML = "";
    }
  }

  init();
})();
</script>
```
